spec: Part III — the Ember color system (six laws: ink acts, ember rewards) + 6.4 motion & haptic language. Feedback is haptics only, never sound. Gap resolutions G4/G5/G8 logged in Appendix A 2026-09-04.

primaryButtonFill.role: 20% Ink — primary button fill (ink acts; ≈15:1 on canvas)

secondaryButtonLabel.spec: Part III table (composed from ink text)

missedGray.role: 20% Ink — missed = warm gray, never red; recedes on dark
missedGray.spec: Part III table + semantics; dark = Decision Registry G4 (2026-09-04)

ember.role: ≤10% Ember — SHAPES only: streak flame, XP count-ups, ring & heat-map fills, PR/comeback/celebration accents; dark lifts, never inverts
ember.spec: Part III table; laws ③ ④ ⑤

emberText.role: ≤10% Ember — any orange WORDS (#FF6600 fails WCAG on light; #FF7A1F clears 4.5:1 on dark)
emberText.spec: Part III table; law ③; 6.5; dark = Decision Registry G4 (2026-09-04)

success.role: Semantic — success (single value in spec; both modes)

danger.role: Semantic — danger (berry, never near orange; single value in spec; both modes)

spacing.spec: Decision Registry G5 (2026-09-04) — 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32, nothing off-scale (points on iOS, px on web). A14 (2026-09-09) adds two ROLE aliases onto that same scale so macro and micro rhythm can diverge without a new number: sectionGap (24) is the gap BETWEEN groups, rowGap (8) the gap WITHIN one — a uniform 16 pt everywhere is why Home read as empty rather than composed.

sizes.spec: GAP (agent, 2026-09-04): component sizes the spec never states, named once so no layout number is typed inline (C7 spirit); points on iOS, px on web

opacity.spec: GAP (agent, 2026-09-04): the one opacity used for a disabled control; named so no literal is typed inline

motion.spec: 6.4 — one spring curve app-wide, defined once; values = Decision Registry G5 (2026-09-04)
